rules.name: API1: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
rules.description: Detects sequential or unauthorized access to API objects by ID indicating broken object-level authorization
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%bola%' OR payload ILIKE '%idor%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API2: Broken Authentication — Default Credentials
rules.description: Detects API authentication attempts using default or well-known credentials
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%authentication%' OR payload ILIKE '%default-credentials%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API3: Broken Object Property Level Authorization (BOPLA)
rules.description: Detects API responses returning sensitive properties that the user should not access
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%bopla%' OR payload ILIKE '%property-level%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API4: Unrestricted Resource Consumption — Rate Limiting
rules.description: Detects API requests exceeding rate limits indicating denial of service or scraping attacks
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%rate-limiting%' OR payload ILIKE '%resource-consumption%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API5: Broken Function Level Authorization
rules.description: Detects access to administrative API endpoints by non-administrative users
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%flba%' OR payload ILIKE '%privilege-escalation%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API6: Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
rules.description: Detects automated or excessive access to business-critical API flows like checkout, transfer, or account creation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%business-flows%' OR payload ILIKE '%automation%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API7: Server-Side Request Forgery via API
rules.description: Detects SSRF attempts through API endpoints targeting internal networks or cloud metadata
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%ssrf%' OR payload ILIKE '%server-side%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API8: Security Misconfiguration — Exposed API Documentation
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to API documentation endpoints like Swagger, OpenAPI, or GraphQL introspection
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%misconfiguration%' OR payload ILIKE '%swagger%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API9: Improper Inventory Management — Shadow API
rules.description: Detects access to undocumented or deprecated API endpoints not in the API inventory
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%shadow-api%' OR payload ILIKE '%inventory%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API10: Unsafe Consumption of API Responses
rules.description: Detects API responses containing executable content or unsafe data that could harm downstream systems
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%unsafe-consumption%' OR payload ILIKE '%response-handling%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API — Mass Assignment via Parameter Tampering
rules.description: Detects mass assignment attacks where request parameters include unauthorized fields like role, isAdmin, or status
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%mass-assignment%' OR payload ILIKE '%parameter-tampering%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API — GraphQL Query Depth Attack
rules.description: Detects GraphQL queries with excessive depth or complexity indicating DoS or data extraction
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%graphql%' OR payload ILIKE '%dos%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API — JWT Token None Algorithm Attack
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with algorithm set to none or missing algorithm indicating authentication bypass
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%jwt%' OR payload ILIKE '%algorithm-none%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API — Excessive Data Exposure in Response
rules.description: Detects API responses returning more data than requested including PII, credentials, or internal fields
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%data-exposure%' OR payload ILIKE '%pii%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API — NoSQL Injection in Request Parameters
rules.description: Detects NoSQL injection operators ($where, $regex, $gt) in API request parameters
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%nosql-injection%' OR payload ILIKE '%injection%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: API — Broken Access Control on API Keys
rules.description: Detects API key usage from unauthorized sources or with excessive permissions
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%api-keys%' OR payload ILIKE '%access-control%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES
